question: Find the full name and nationality of the driver who set the fastest lap time (in milliseconds) at any circuit located in Japan, along with the name of that race and the year it occurred.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", d."XCL_041", r."XCL_069", r."XCL_066"
FROM lapTimes AS lt
INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Japan'
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" ASC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.
Lap time recorded in the second qualifying session (Q2). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q1, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q1 times.
Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

WITH fastest_lap_times AS (
  SELECT T1."XCL_074", T1."XCL_075",
    (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(T1."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
    + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1."XCL_088", INSTR(T1."XCL_088", ':') + 1, INSTR(T1."XCL_088", '.') - INSTR(T1."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL))
    + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1."XCL_088", INSTR(T1."XCL_088", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
  FROM results AS T1
  WHERE T1."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
),
min_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(flt."time_in_seconds") AS min_time_in_seconds
  FROM fastest_lap_times AS flt
  INNER JOIN races AS r ON flt."XCL_074" = r."XCL_065"
  INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
  WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Japan'
)
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", d."XCL_041", r."XCL_069", r."XCL_066"
FROM fastest_lap_times AS flt
INNER JOIN races AS r ON flt."XCL_074" = r."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON flt."XCL_075" = d."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN min_time AS m ON flt."time_in_seconds" = m."min_time_in_seconds"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Japan'
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
    d.XCL_039 AS nationality,
    r.XCL_069 AS race_name,
    r.XCL_066 AS year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'Japan'
ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
LIMIT 1
